title: schkuhria anthemoidea
intro: Schkuhria anthemoidea, commonly known as Yerba de la Santa Maria or Sacred Marigold, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is traditionally used for its medicinal and spiritual properties, particularly in the treatment of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Schkuhria anthemoidea include its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an expectorant, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant activities.
